ja: • 山手線開業130周年を記念したYamanote Historyシリーズ。
• 1985年に登場した国鉄初のステンレス製通勤型電車。車体重量が軽量で経済的なメリットもある。山手線、京阪神緩行線で最初に投入された後は、他の路線でも多数投入された。
• 山手線に投入された205系は乗降客扉の窓が小さい初期タイプのもの。
• 先頭車（スカート２種）＋中間車（屋根２種：パンタ付き／パンタなし）の２両セット。
• NEW SGフレーム、ステッカー付属。
en: • Yamanote History series commemorating the 130th anniversary of the opening of the Yamanote Line.

• JNR's first stainless steel commuter train introduced in 1985. It also has the advantage of being lightweight and economical. After being first introduced on the Yamanote Line and Keihanshin Local Line, many other lines were also introduced.
• The 205 series introduced on the Yamanote Line was an early type with a small window on the passenger door.
• A 2-car set including the lead car (2 types of skirts) + the middle car (2 types of roof: with/without panties).
• NEW SG frame and sticker included.
